name: planhaus
description: Interior-design copilot that follows the professional design process: brief → concept → zoning → circulation → layout → FF&E selection → lighting → review. Spatial reasoning with a cited clearance rules engine, room geometry validation, floorplan rendering, product catalog search, and 60-30-10 composition discipline.
